source_snapshot.procedure: Operator on BMC UART sets TFTP, loads BMC binary to0x83000000, `sf probe 0`, `sf update ... 0 0x4000000`, `saveenv`, resets and checks BMC.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL operator flash plus agent OOB version check; warns of brick risk.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: RPUC/critical; requires exact image, layout, size, power and recovery but exposes password in suggested CLI.

old_problem: The literal 64MiB offset-zero write may exceed the transferred image or overwrite boot/environment/recovery/calibration; target SPI identity, signed image, allowed regions, `saveenv` policy, backup and independent recovery are unspecified.
disposition_reason: ED-07 preserves the approved flash and pre/post version coverage but requires a separate critical authorization. Runtime placeholders can parameterize TFTP and credentials; they cannot establish board/image compatibility, safe offset/length or recoverability. ED-15 therefore forbids PASS until signed project artifacts define those core properties.
decision_basis: Read XLSX row144, same-row AI fields and history2532; unique identity confirmed.
Preserved UART/TFTP, RAM0x83000000, SPI0, offset0, stated0x4000000, `saveenv`, reset and full BMC post-check coverage.
Required `$filesize`/image hash, JEDEC/capacity and region-map comparison before any write.
No UART, flash, reset, network change, retry or DUT action occurred.

test_case.purpose: Under qualified operator control, flash the exact approved BMC image through U-Boot and prove intended firmware activation with preserved configuration, non-target regions and recovery capability.
required_package: Exact SUT/board/BMC and SPI JEDEC/capacity/region map
Signed image filename/version/hash/length and compatibility manifest
Approved RAM address, flash offset/length and allowed changed regions
Decision whether `saveenv` is required plus environment/network oracle
Stable power, complete backup, golden/external recovery, timeout and secure credentials
test_case.test_command: After separate critical authorization, validate target/image/layout/backup/recovery; operator captures continuous UART, TFTP byte count and SPI identity, writes exactly the approved region once (never inferred fixed length), verifies if supported, applies approved `saveenv` policy, resets, then securely collects firmware/bank/services/network/configuration/sensors/inventory/SEL and non-target preservation evidence.
test_case.expected_result: Signed target image is written only to the approved region and activates; BMC returns within timeout on the expected bank/version, all required management functions/configuration/sensors/logs are healthy, non-target data is preserved and recovery remains available.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires immutable target/image/hash/size/layout proof, successful bounded write/verification, intended version/bank and complete health/configuration evidence. Any mismatch, uncertain write, unexpected region/environment change, rollback/recovery boot or lost management access fails/blocks per engineer; write success alone is insufficient.
safety_gate: Obtain explicit flash authorization for exact target, image, offset and byte count.
Verify TFTP `$filesize`, RAM bounds, SPI JEDEC/capacity and signed layout before write.
Back up required regions and prove independent recovery/stable power.
Do not persist temporary network variables unless approved; never retry an uncertain flash automatically.
expected_evidence: Target/SPI/layout identity and approved change map
Signed image metadata and pre-flash firmware/bank/configuration baseline
Backups, recovery readiness, maintenance authorization and stable-power record
Full UART/TFTP/SPI transcript with exact byte counts and verification
Post-flash version/bank, secure OOB service/configuration/sensor/inventory/SEL and non-target-region evidence
Recovery actions if any and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: If any identity/hash/size/probe/write/verification check fails, do not reset or retry blindly. Preserve UART state and execute only the pre-approved golden-bank or external-programmer recovery, then revalidate the complete BMC baseline.

blocked.reason: The operator-controlled flash workflow is identifiable; it remains RPUC pending exact project authorization rather than pipeline BLOCKED.
